title: Round-Neck Sequin High Waist Short-Sleeved Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
The round neckline and short sleeves offer a classic look, while the high-waisted silhouette elongates the figure. The sequin embellishments on the upper body add a touch of glamour, making it perfect for any special occasion where you want to make a stylish entrance.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
